purpose: Compare Designs 1, 2 and 3; shared application/model measurements are supplementary context

notes: These are measurement definitions. No pass/fail limits have been supplied.
Raw application storage is different from dependencies, a production build, installed footprint, or a packaged Electron executable.
The Maintainability Index currently covers Python only; JavaScript/JSX is not assigned a fabricated equivalent score.
Simulated browser input-to-display latency does not include physical sensor sampling, USB/Wi-Fi delivery, or monitor scanout.
Runtime RAM is sampled resident memory for the isolated browser process group plus its backend process group; shared pages can be counted more than once.
Model complexity counts triangles for the current procedural dogs; it is not a polygon count for an unavailable final Blender asset.

model_complexity.polygon_count_reason: The models use triangulated BufferGeometry. Original authored polygon or quad counts cannot be inferred from triangle indices.
model_complexity.scope: One visible canine model before camera frustum or occlusion culling; model geometry only, not lights, camera, tracking graphics or multiple GPU render passes.

count_definitions.triangle_count: Sum of floor(drawable index or nonindexed position count / 3) per visible mesh/material group, multiplied by InstancedMesh.count when applicable.
count_definitions.stored_vertex_count: Sum of position-attribute entry counts over unique mesh geometries, including seam duplicates and hidden mesh geometry.
count_definitions.instance_vertex_count: Sum of complete position-attribute entry counts per mesh instance, including hidden mesh instances; this is not a count of vertices processed by the GPU.
count_definitions.visible_instance_vertex_count: Complete position-attribute entry counts per visible mesh instance that contributes triangles; not reduced for draw ranges or culling.
count_definitions.mesh_count: Scene graph mesh objects; InstancedMesh remains one object and its instances are counted separately.
count_definitions.stored_index_count: Index-buffer element counts over unique geometries; these are indices, not vertices or triangles.

limitations: Static geometry measurement; no browser, WebGL frame timing, runtime memory, or GPU performance is measured.
Triangle totals do not remove back-facing, degenerate, hidden-by-other-geometry or off-camera triangles.
Wireframe mode, shadow passes, multi-view rendering, LOD selection and non-mesh primitives are outside this measurement.
Current canine models are procedural approximations; repeat the measurement for fitted Blender/GLB assets when those are integrated.

method.latency_start: performance.now immediately before clicking the actual Low/High simulated-angle UI button
method.latency_end: matching fresh numeric angle and visible feedback modal after React DOM commit and two requestAnimationFrame callbacks
method.graphics: headless Edge with explicit SwiftShader software rendering; not final hardware GPU or Electron measurements
method.comparison_limit: Synthetic markers and non-coded texture do not validate unchanged-pad tracking or physical sensor latency. Mode order is sequential, not randomized.
method.process_isolation: Fresh seeded Python backend and fresh temporary Edge profile per mode; private SQLite records; same production build, patient, injection stage, 1440x900 viewport and 1280x720 synthetic camera at 12 fps

runtime.repeat_order: Rotate the first mode on each repeat; each repeat otherwise sequential. No statistical randomization is claimed.

physical_sensor_latency.reason: No physical ESP32 sampling/transport-to-display trial was performed.
